map.ROI = 签约金额 ÷（展位费+搭建费+差旅费）总成本。结果仅按你输入的本地数: ROI = contracted amount / total cost (booth fee + build cost + travel). Results are computed only from the local data you enter and are for reference when hidden costs are not included.
map.→ 打开会后（评估/报告/跟进）总结工具: -> Open the post-event (evaluation / report / follow-up) summary tool
map.会后评估/报告/跟进总结工具。按投入产出分析与客户跟进维度，生成展会后效果评估与: Post-event evaluation / report / follow-up summary tool. Working from return on investment and customer follow-up dimensions, it generates a post-show effect evaluation and follow-up report to help sales teams capture leads and review results.
map.单线索成本 = 总成本 ÷ 收集线索数，用于横向比较不同展会的获客效率，数值越低: Cost per lead = total cost / number of leads collected, used to compare the acquisition efficiency of different shows; a lower figure means more economical acquisition.
map.单线索成本有什么用？: What is the cost per lead used for?
map.安全（疏散/消防/承重）评估: Safety (evacuation / fire protection / load bearing) evaluation
map.展会结束后录入展位、搭建、差旅总成本与签约金额，立即得到 ROI，快速判断本届展: After the show, enter the total booth, build and travel cost plus the contracted amount to get the ROI immediately and judge quickly whether this edition met its return target.
map.按 ROI 等级（优异/良好/一般/不佳）自动生成跟进建议，指导销售团队 1 周: Follow-up advice is generated automatically from the ROI grade (excellent / good / average / poor), guiding the sales team to contact leads within 1 week and revisit qualified prospects within 2 weeks.
map.结合到访人数、收集线索、意向客户与现场签约，测算线索转化率与单线索成本，定位获客: Combine visitor numbers, leads collected, qualified prospects and on-site signings to compute the lead conversion rate and cost per lead, locating weak links in acquisition.
map.：输入展位费 5 万、搭建 3 万、差旅 2 万、到访 500 人、线索 120: : entering a booth fee of 50,000 CNY, build 30,000 CNY, travel 20,000 CNY, 500 visitors, 120 leads, 45 qualified prospects and 8 signings worth 250,000 CNY, the tool outputs ROI ~= 1.67, total investment 100,000 CNY, lead conversion 24% and cost per lead about 833 CNY, with a "good results" follow-up recommendation.
